sources.title: H100 vs RTX 4090: Benchmark for AI Workloads - Cloudzy Blog
sources.snippet: Quick Answer: H100 vs RTX 4090 for AI Workloads H100 wins for big-model training and serious serving because it brings large HBM pools, very high memory bandwidth, NVLink, and MIG for isolation. RTX 4090 is better for "I need great single-GPU speed at a better price" as long as your workload fits into 24 GB without constant compromises.
